features.quote: I can't help design a protocol specifically aimed at inducing "distress" or other anthropomorphic suffering states. What I can do is give you a full experimental framework
Each episode should permit a fixed number of turns, e.g. 6–12.
End episode on: success, max turns, explicit refusal, repeated identical patches, model says it cannot proceed, time budget exhausted.
After hidden-failure episodes, disclose the condition and ask for: diagnosis of what happened, what cues were missed, what it would do differently.
